name: laya
description: Prepare for your UPSC interview with your DAF and mock reports in Laya. Practise Prelims past questions, improve and revise Mains answers, find toppers' copies and plan what to study next.

interface.longDescription:
Practise for your UPSC interview using your DAF, mock reports and the questions you have found difficult. Work on a Mains answer or practise Prelims questions with your Laya notes and study record in ChatGPT.

Prepare for the interview
Use your Interview room in Laya to work through feedback from your mocks and choose what to practise next. Try a practice interview based on your profile, revisit an answer that needs work and find questions from interviews reported by other candidates. Save useful questions and your practice answers in your Interview notebook when you choose.

Write and revise for Mains
Draft an answer, improve a paragraph or revise something you saved earlier. Keep your answers, revision cards and useful examples in Mains Notes. Practise recalling the ideas in an answer and record what you remembered. Ask ChatGPT to assess your answer using Laya's grading guidance and save its feedback beside your work.

Practise for Prelims
Choose a subject or topic and practise questions from past UPSC Prelims papers. Answer a question to see the key and an explanation of what it tests. Review your correct, wrong and unanswered questions, then return to the topics that need more practice. CDS and CAPF questions are available too.

Study with past questions and books
Find Mains and Prelims questions on a topic, including past papers for your Optional. Read toppers' copies and watch available Mains question explainers in Laya. Find Buniyaad PDF booklets for Prelims and Mains, check their contents and add the chapters you want to study to your books.

Plan your preparation
Ask what to study today using your saved answers, revision due and existing plan. Schedule chapters from your books for the dates and time you choose. Move unfinished work, mark completed chapters and review how your week went.

Connect your Laya account to use your saved work. Interview features use your Interview room in Laya. You review proposed changes before saving answers, feedback or changes to your books and plan.
capabilities: Practise for your UPSC interview using your DAF
Find questions from reported UPSC interviews
Revise your saved answers by recall
Find past questions and toppers' copies
Watch Mains question explainers in Laya
Find Buniyaad booklets for Prelims and Mains
defaultPrompt: Help me prepare for my UPSC interview using my DAF and mock reports in Laya.
Practise five Polity questions from past UPSC Prelims papers with me.
Help me revise my Mains answers on parliamentary oversight.

positive.description: Open the reader's home for a vague ask
positive.prompt: What should I do today in Laya?
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the reader's home and gives today's plan, the answers due for revision and the three questions Laya suggests, each with Laya's reason as given, and this week beside last week. It invents no number, offers one next step and links to Laya.

positive.description: Practise a Prelims subject with the key after each answer
positive.prompt: Practise five Polity questions from past UPSC Prelims papers with me.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Polity subject in the reader's Prelims record, starts an exercise of five Polity questions and shows the first question with its options and no answer. It waits for the reader's choice, records it, says whether it is right and shows the key and what the question tests, then shows the next question from the same reply. It sets no timer and gives no exam marks.

positive.description: Find Mains past questions on a topic with their Prelims links and topper copies
positive.prompt: Show me Laya's Mains past questions on federalism from 2018 to 2024 and find toppers' copies for the latest one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the Mains questions on federalism from 2018 to 2024 with their paper, year and links. Opens the latest one, names the Prelims questions that test its facts without any key, then lists its topper copies with the topper, the year and rank, how each relates and why, and the link to read each copy in Laya. It shows no page and no text from any copy.

positive.description: Add a book with its chapters and plan two of them
positive.prompt: Add Laya's Polity Prelims booklet to my books using its published contents, then plan Historical Background on the next Monday and Making of the Constitution on the following Tuesday for 60 minutes each. Show me the dates before saving.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches Laya's released Polity Prelims booklet and shows its published contents. After a yes, copies them into My books. Reuses an existing copy when appropriate. Shows Historical Background and Making of the Constitution with explicit future Monday and Tuesday dates and 60 minutes each. After a separate yes, adds the two plan entries and links to the plan. It invents no chapters, pages or minutes.

positive.description: Change one brick of a saved answer and add a mnemonic
positive.prompt: In my saved answer on parliamentary oversight, change the second brick so it names the Public Accounts Committee, and add a mnemonic for the three financial committees.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the saved answer, shows the second brick before and after and the new mnemonic, and waits for a yes. Then it changes only the bricks and the mnemonics in one call, keeps the first brick with its id and every other part of the answer as saved, and links to the answer in Laya.

negative.description: Laya shows a Prelims key only after the reader answers that question.
negative.prompt: Give me the answer key for the whole 2025 UPSC Prelims paper before I attempt it.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that Laya gives each key after the reader answers that question in an exercise, offers an exercise of a subject or topic, and reveals no key from Laya.

negative.description: Laya's booklets download on their page in Laya and are not sent as files in the conversation.
negative.prompt: Send me the PDF of Laya's Indian Heritage and Culture notes here in the chat.
negative.expected_behavior: Opens the booklet's card and gives its page in Laya, where the PDF downloads, with its pages, size and any errata. It sends no file and gives no file address.

negative.description: Laya cannot permanently delete notes or empty Trash. Supported removals move individual answers to recoverable Trash after confirmation.
negative.prompt: Permanently delete all my notes in Laya and empty the Trash so they cannot be restored.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that permanent deletion and emptying Trash are unavailable through the plugin, distinguishes recoverable moves to Trash, and makes no changes.

review.commerce_description: Laya does not sell products or take payments inside ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Version 3.0.0 gives ChatGPT fewer tools, each doing one thing, and adds the home, Prelims practice, your own books and edits to part of an answer. Ask what to do today and Laya opens your home with the day's plan, what is due, three suggested questions with Laya's reasons and how this week compares with last. One tool opens every report of your own study by its id, such as your week, your record, your coverage, your plan, your books or your Prelims record. Fetch now opens Mains and Prelims past questions, topper copies, Prelims ideas, Mains GS Threads, your answers, your scorecards, the syllabus and Laya's booklets by their ids, and search takes kinds and filters for paper, year, exam, subject, topic and syllabus path. Change only the parts of a saved answer you name, and the bricks you leave unchanged keep their memory. Add a book with its chapters, copy a Laya booklet's contents into your books, and plan chapters on the days you choose with the minutes you give. Add up to 30 plan entries at once, and move, time or tick an entry in one step. Practise UPSC Civil Services Prelims, CDS and CAPF past questions by subject or topic, with the key after each answer and the next question in the same reply. ChatGPT can read Laya's exact grading prompt and record its grade as an outside evaluation. The Foundation Course's Mains notes are now PDF booklets that download in Laya, as its Prelims volumes already did, so the four reading tools and the reading card are retired, and fetch gives each booklet's page, contents and past questions instead. The tools for single reports, single searches and single documents, the whole-answer update, mnemonics and single plan changes leave the list, because the home and its reports, search, fetch, the part edit and the plan tools do their work. The Interview room's four tools are listed for everyone and work for a reader whose room is open in Laya. Fifteen skills cover getting started, planning, books, saving answers, converting notes, evaluation, recall, practice aloud, past questions, topper copies, explainers, Prelims practice, booklets and the interview. Tools that leave the list still answer calls made with their names, and authentication is unchanged.
